summary: Remove process.env reads from src/core/flowable-client.ts (lines ~264/269/274) by lifting them to the composition root (bridge-runner.ts, bridge-smoke-runner.ts); extend ci/checks/keyed-digest-core-purity.sh to cover the full src/core/ tree with positive/negative self-tests so the no-env-in-core invariant is fully enforced.
functional: FR-1: makeFlowableClient no longer reads process.env for baseUrl, adminUser, or adminPassword. All three values must be supplied by the caller via config, or makeFlowableClient throws on missing adminPassword.
FR-2: bridge-runner.ts and bridge-smoke-runner.ts read the three env vars locally (in their src/ scope) and pass a full config object to makeFlowableClient, preserving runtime behavior.
FR-3: ci/checks/keyed-digest-core-purity.sh is extended to scan all of src/core/ (not just the three masking modules), using the same comment-strip + grep method already in place.
non_functional: NF-1: makeFlowableClient with a fully supplied config behaves identically before and after — all existing unit tests pass without modification.
NF-2: npx tsc --noEmit passes after the change (no type regressions).
NF-3: The positive self-test (planted violation detected → exit 1) and negative self-test (comment-only mention → no match) remain in the updated check.
NF-4: No || true suppression around the real assertion grep in the updated check.
out_of_scope: Modifying flowable-client test files (all pass explicit TEST_CONFIG; no env fallback relied upon).

acceptance_criteria.text: makeFlowableClient({ baseUrl, adminUser, adminPassword, ... }) with a full explicit config behaves identically to before. All tests in src/__tests__/flowable-client.test.ts and src/__tests__/flowable-client.adversarial.test.ts pass without modification.

makeFlowableClient() with zero args (no config) throws Error('FLOWABLE_REST_APP_ADMIN_PASSWORD is required'). No process.env read for baseUrl, adminUser, or adminPassword occurs inside src/core/flowable-client.ts.

After the change, grep -rn 'process\.env' src/core/ returns no code-line matches (comment-only mentions are not counted). The updated ci/checks/keyed-digest-core-purity.sh scans the full src/core/ tree and exits 0.

Positive self-test of the updated check: a planted process.env['PLANTED'] on a code line inside src/core/ is detected and the check exits 1. If the planted violation is not detected the check exits 2 (self-test broken).

npm test is green after the change. Specifically: src/__tests__/keyed-digest-e2e.test.ts, src/__tests__/hash-oracle.test.ts, src/__tests__/data-classification.test.ts, src/__tests__/grant-resolver.test.ts, and src/__tests__/main-wired-entry.test.ts all pass without modification.

bridge-runner.ts and bridge-smoke-runner.ts read FLOWABLE_BASE_URL, FLOWABLE_REST_APP_ADMIN_USER_ID (or equivalent), and FLOWABLE_REST_APP_ADMIN_PASSWORD from process.env locally and pass them as an explicit config object to makeFlowableClient. npx tsc --noEmit passes.

The updated ci/checks/keyed-digest-core-purity.sh has its SCOPE NOTE updated to reflect that the full src/core/ sweep is now achievable (T-0163 removed the flowable-client.ts blocker). The header references T-0163.
